name: com.streethawk.library.gcm.SimpleGCMIntentService
description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. Google Cloud Messaging starts this older StreetHawk service when a message is delivered. It is the SDK's GCM entry point and delegates delivery to StreetHawk's message handler.
disableEffect: StreetHawk push messages delivered through this older integration will stop.
